lines.t: Come, all those who know not my ways I will show you
Come, all those who have been abandoned
I will comfort you and give you shelter
Come all those who are crippled
Let us run and leap for joy together
come all murderers watch me raise you and all who sleep from the grave
come all you who blaspheme i will give you a new voice bring with you all those who are blind and
death for they too shall see here indeed come all those who have sinned against me take my hand
i will lead you to the waters where i shall wash you
and where your new clothes hang upon the tree which grows next to the stream come on come on
Ask and it shall be given you
For all things are possible with God
And they manifest through the Son
